items.source:
Register type-specific hints and AOT artifacts for domain types, reachable types, projection interfaces derived
from query method return types, and annotations from org.springframework.data packages.
items.translation: 为领域类型、可达类型（由查询方法返回类型派生的投影接口）以及来自 org.springframework.data 包的注解注册特定类型的提示和 AOT 工件。

items.source: This method allows for the creation to be overridden by subclasses.
items.translation: 此方法允许子类覆盖该创建过程。

items.source: repositoryContext - the repository context.
items.translation: repositoryContext - 仓库上下文。

items.source: generationContext - the generation context.
items.translation: generationContext - 生成上下文。

items.source: With registerRepositoryCompositionHints(AotRepositoryContext, GenerationContext) (specifically configureTypeContribution(Class, AotContext) and contributeAotRepository(AotRepositoryContext), stores can provide custom logic for contributing additional (e.g. reflection) configuration. By default, reflection configuration will be added for types reachable from the repository declaration and query methods as well as all used annotations from the org.springframework.data namespace.
items.translation: 通过registerRepositoryCompositionHints(AotRepositoryContext, GenerationContext)（具体为configureTypeContribution(Class, AotContext)和contributeAotRepository(AotRepositoryContext)），存储库可以提供自定义逻辑以贡献额外的（例如反射）配置。默认情况下，将为从存储库声明和查询方法可达的类型以及所有来自 org.springframework.data 命名空间的注解添加反射配置。

items.source: Processes repository factory beans to provide generic type information to the AOT tooling to allow deriving target type from the bean definition. If generic types do not match due to customization of the factory bean by the user, at least the target repository type is provided via the FactoryBean.OBJECT_TYPE_ATTRIBUTE.
items.translation: 处理 仓库工厂 Bean，以向 AOT 工具提供泛型类型信息，从而能够从 Bean 定义 推导出目标类型。如果由于用户自定义工厂 Bean 而导致泛型类型不匹配，则至少通过 FactoryBean.OBJECT_TYPE_ATTRIBUTE 提供目标仓库类型。

items.source: The processor is typically configured via RepositoryConfigurationExtension.getRepositoryAotProcessor() and gets added by the RepositoryConfigurationDelegate.
items.translation: 处理器通常通过RepositoryConfigurationExtension.getRepositoryAotProcessor()进行配置，并由RepositoryConfigurationDelegate添加。
